physical.area_reference_basis: McPAT non-cache area plus Table II L1I/L1D/L2 area for 4-core 32kB/512kB reference

thermal_stack.calibration: Recalibrated after CACTI/Table-II cache geometry fix: Table III FFT 64kB/1MB gives 124.39 C at R_conv=5.0 K/W; validate against remaining anchors

paper: 32x32 power grid on each active tier
T_safe=95 C, T_amb=25 C, f_min=0.4 GHz
reproduction_assumptions: alpha, beta, cross-tier weight, and lambda_wire are not numerically disclosed by the paper; defaults are explicit and configurable.
McPAT uses direct gem5 O3 counters and a documented global Table III FFT-anchor calibration; raw powers remain in mcpat.json.
CACTI effective delay, area, and aspect-ratio-preserving geometry come from published Table II plus the local CACTI shape; local raw outputs remain as measured_* fields.

The 8.72 effective local stack-resistance factor was recalibrated after cache geometry began using CACTI/Table-II areas; it reconstructs an unpublished Cool-3D material stack from the Table III FFT anchor and requires cross-anchor validation.
CLIP-3D proposals and fixed-bin are both validated with real HotSpot; a guard prevents a proxy-induced thermal-BIPS regression and records any fallback.
Cool3D-standard and SA+lambda details are under-specified; their deterministic reproduction algorithms record all parameters and candidates.
